LightningComponentBundle.description: Small multiples sparkline grid for entity comparison, powered by D3.js.

property.name: soqlQuery
property.label: SOQL Query
property.placeholder: SELECT Type, CloseDate, Amount FROM Opportunity ORDER BY CloseDate

property.name: entityField
property.label: Entity Field
property.description: API name of the field to group entities by (e.g., Type, Owner)

property.name: dateField
property.label: Date Field
property.description: API name of the date field for the time axis

property.name: valueField
property.label: Value Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field to aggregate

property.name: operation
property.label: Aggregation
property.description: How to aggregate the values per time bucket

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Drill-Down Object
property.description: Object API name for navigation on click

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field to filter by on drill-down (defaults to Entity Field)
